question.text: For the annual PPM compliance audit, SEBI has made the audit of certain PPM sections OPTIONAL. Which of the following is NOT among the sections whose audit is optional?

answer.text: Distribution Waterfall and Class of Units Review

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Per Section 13.5.2, audit of the following sections is OPTIONAL: Risk Factors, Legal/Regulatory/Tax Considerations, Track Record of First Time Managers, Illustration of Fees and Expenses, Glossary and Terms. Distribution Waterfall and Class of Units review, capital commitments and drawdowns, and management fees per class are part of MANDATORY audit scope (they are the commercial heart of investor protection). **The Trap:** All four sound 'boring' and hence auditable-optional, but Distribution Waterfall is mandatory — it's the commercial heart of investor protection. **Cross-Exam Context:** XIX-A tests PPM audit existence. XIX-C requires knowing scope carve-outs — useful when scoping the audit RFP with an external firm. **Manager's Pro-Tip:** Even though Risk Factors / Legal / Tax are optional for audit, have your internal counsel refresh them annually — LPs will blame the manager for stale risk disclosures regardless of 'audit optional' status.
